mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating consumer demand and economic weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by strong GDP growth (GDPC1) and elevated retail sales (RSAFS), overvaluation and impending rate hikes cause S&P 500 underperformance, generating negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2% and RSAFS > 400,000), SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tight labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE remains below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 3-month unemployment rate increase above 5.0% signals economic distress and reduced consumer confidence, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates stagflationary pressures that squeeze corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and CPIAUCSL rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO above 100) signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods of INDPRO growth above 1.0% monthly, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
